description: This file defines the `SugarRegistry` class, which implements a singleton pattern for managing global registry data in the SuiteCRM application. It provides methods for storing, retrieving, and unsetting global data, as well as adding data to the global scope.

classes.name: SugarRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class for managing a global registry of key-value pairs, supporting access, mutation, and exporting to the global scope.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the SugarRegistry class. It initializes internal data structures but is empty in this implementation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of SugarRegistry identified by a given name (default is 'default'). Creates a new instance if one does not already exist for the name.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve a value from the registry data by key. Returns null if the key does not exist.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set a key-value pair in the registry data.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if a key exists in the registry data.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Magic method to remove a key from the registry data.

methods.name: addToGlobals
methods.description: Exports all stored registry data to the PHP global variables array.
